collectionunit.notes: Top 218 cm of core was spoil deposits in the dike, which was built in the 1940s. Local vegetation: Typha-Scirpus marsh and Chenopod mudflats.
collectionunit.location: on a dike near center of marsh

chronology.notes: Chron uses top of marsh deposits (0 BP) and 5 C14 dates. Date DIC-3313 rejected (see Fredlund 1995). Unconformity at 588 cm (Fredlund 1995). Linear interpolation between top 3 dates plus extrapolation to 578 cm. Fit a least-squares straight line to bottom

geochron.geochronnotes: All dates are problematic because of incorporation of old carbon. Fredlund (1995) rejects DIC-3313.

site.sitedescription: Shallow marsh in structural basin. Physiography: Cheyenne Bottoms wetland. Surrounding vegetation: Typha-Scirpus marsh/Chenopod mudflats.
